GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: bumped start crowded & Eased Settled Worse than midfield 4.5l home turn 4l angled to inside worse going tried hard # worse going/forgive
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: Bumped on jumping and, shortly after, had to be eased when crowded for room. From a wide barrier was then shifted behind runners in the early stages.

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Jumped Ok Settled Down Mid Field 4 lengths. looking for run turn. battled away # Even Effort
Slow Out 1 length went through to settle 3rd 3 lengths. got up fence turn joining leader. got clear in Straight . just found enough # Every Chance
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: Was contacted on jumping by rnr which shifted in. Was held up rounding the home turn.

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: jumped ok. Went Forward and Settled Down 3rd Two Wide 2.5 L. eased wider turn and Straightened Up 3rd Ridden Along 3 Wide in clear. took Lead near 250m but Headed near 150m and tired quickly from there. vetted and # mild heat stress
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: After the 50m when weakening, had to be eased from heels. When questioned regarding the performance of the gelding, rider stated that his mount travelled well until straightening but did not respond to his riding and weakened in the run to the line and was disappointing. A post-race veterinary examination revealed the gelding to have mild heat stress.

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: jumped ok. Went Forward Wide gate and Settled Down Leader Two Wide 0.5 L. joined before 600m and Straightened Up sharing Lead p/a off rail. took front soon after/got clear but nailed last bound. # 59.5kg/led/brave
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: When questioned re settling forward in today’s event, rdr stated he had received no specific instructions, however after beginning well and when riders to his inside were showing little intent to go forward, rather than be caught wide he allowed his mnt to stride forward and sit outside the leader.

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Jumped Ok Restrained Settled Down 8th Inside 6 Lengths Good Pace on, off Inside Straightening Up Restricted Room held-up to 200 and again from 150 - a must forget - # no joy straight
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: Held up from the 400m until passing the 250m where it was directed to the outside of rnr to obtain clear running. Approaching the 150m was eased when crowded, then remained held up until near the 50m.
